preconditions.description: The number of test cases t must be between 1 and 100000.
The length of each string a must be between 1 and 100000.

preconditions.expression: all(c in 'ANTO' for c in a)
preconditions.description: Each character in string a must be one of 'A', 'N', 'O', or 'T'.
The total length of all strings a across all test cases must not exceed 100000.

postconditions.description: The output string b must be a permutation of the input string a.
The length of the output string b must be equal to the length of the input string a.

postconditions.expression: all(c in 'ANTO' for c in b)
postconditions.description: Each character in the output string b must be one of 'A', 'N', 'O', or 'T'.
